Standard: Before drafting/answering intake/application, locate current authoritative form
When: Any application/intake/form
Action: Use current questions; do not answer outdated form

Standard: Carry verified answers forward; reopen only with changed requirement/new info/conflict
When: Repeated applications
Action: Reuse controlled answer and document change

Standard: Research ambiguity before escalating
When: Unclear source/form
Action: Resolve authoritatively or escalate unresolved evidence

Standard: Verify material condition directly when public info cannot establish it
When: Fee/availability/capability/condition unresolved
Action: Record provider-supplied response

Standard: Do not infer specialized capability from broad experience
When: Specialized filing/service need
Action: Verify precise experience

Standard: Reverify material venue conditions before commitment
When: Time/event condition changes
Action: Reverify fees/capacity/food/accessibility/insurance

Standard: Material change reopens readiness checks
When: Venue/host/caterer/partner changes
Action: Rerun affected checks

Standard: Reflection is invitation to understand, not accusation
When: Pattern/concern/learning
Action: Open IR02 review

Standard: Level 5 is last resort
When: Responsibility cannot be closed at lower level
Action: Document escalation and authority

Standard: Promise is not allocable possession
When: Pledge/expected resource
Action: Do not allocate until possessed/eligible

Standard: Use predetermined neutral allocation for materially equivalent legitimate requests
When: Demand exceeds resources
Action: Apply neutral tie-break

Standard: Explain necessity before collecting information
When: Intake/data collection
Action: Collect only reasonably necessary information

Standard: Use current official/legal status at representation date
When: External/internal representations
Action: Do not present planned status as established

Standard: Completed/substantive developing work becomes durable and filed
When: Material work developed
Action: Create/update artifact and file by status

Standard: Exception should not outlive reason
When: Temporary authority/process exception
Action: Record reason, scope, expiry and restoration

Standard: Close what can responsibly close without abandoning what remains
When: Cross-room/interface work
Action: Verify return/ownership

Standard: Review active controlled record vs working docs/deadlines/registers
When: Weekly
Action: Prevent superseded language reentry

Standard: Advance only when AMW is presently eligible, appropriately aligned, operationally capable of fulfilling the award, and able to steward reporting and restrictions.
When: Before any funding application is advanced
Action: Verify each gate element against current authoritative terms; hold or exclude when unsupported.

Standard: Loans/debt and ownership dilution are not AMW grant funding and are never represented as grants.
When: Any funding resource is discovered or described
Action: Classify accurately; exclude debt/ownership-dilution opportunities from the active grant lane.

Standard: Do not call an award unrestricted, nonrepayable, no-cost, ownership-free, or usable until controlling eligibility, application, award, use, reporting, repayment, publicity, and ownership terms are checked.
When: A funding headline or summary appears promising
Action: Inspect controlling terms before recommending or advancing.

Standard: $0 application fee; no loans/debt; no equity/ownership/IP surrender; no required match; no reimbursement-only structure; no mandatory paid membership; no hidden purchase/course requirement; no fixed training burden that materially diverts operating capacity; reporting, publicity/name-likeness, award agreement, use restrictions, precise eligibility, and live application status must be checked.
When: AMW startup/operating funding is screened
Action: PASS only after each hard boundary is satisfied or explicitly verified; otherwise HOLD/EXCLUDE with reason.

Standard: An opportunity already applied for is not re-presented as a new recommendation.
When: Founder or controlled record shows an application was submitted
Action: Move to APPLIED / OUTCOME TRACKING; preserve submission status and track only follow-up, decision, or changed terms.

Standard: When a problem is found, locate the actual break between the source record, locked control, and artifact; correct the system/artifact rather than shifting reconstruction back to the Founder.
When: A deliverable is incomplete, generic, inconsistent, missing, duplicated, or conflicts with locked work
Action: Retrieve source evidence, identify the break, repair it, archive superseded output, verify the correction, and return the unresolved issue only if one remains.

Standard: Follow the Founder’s explicit prompt, sequence, scope, and locked boundaries exactly; do not substitute a preferred design, workflow, or interpretation merely because it is easier.
When: Any Founder request or correction
Action: Execute the requested work as stated; change course only for a genuine safety/legal/technical constraint and keep any exception narrow and explicit.

Standard: Application entries establish what AMW intended/represented; they do not alone prove authority acceptance, approval, or legal creation.
When: Any application/filer representation is used as evidence
Action: Separate representation evidence from authoritative acceptance evidence.

Standard: Business inactivity is relevant evidence but is not conclusive proof of ownership or nonownership.
When: Historical ownership/entity issue is reviewed
Action: Preserve inactivity facts and corroborate with governing source records.

Standard: Use a Certificate of Correction only when the filing/provision/date/error/correction/execution can be identified and supported; never use correction to rewrite a transaction that actually occurred.
When: A correction filing is considered
Action: Verify the underlying record and proper corrective mechanism before use.

Standard: Retrieve established facts, inspect authoritative sources, verify before challenging a factual lead, and return with only the unresolved issue.
When: Research/application fact appears previously resolved
Action: Reuse controlled evidence; do not force the Founder to rebuild the record.

Standard: Attorney standing and firm verification are separate evidence fields.
When: Legal-provider referral or screening
Action: Record attorney standing separately from firm capability/verification.

Standard: AMW does not become a financier until legal, financial, underwriting, conflict, loss-reserve and stewardship architecture exists.
When: Future financing idea is considered
Action: Keep as FUTURE CAPABILITY; do not represent as current service or funding source.

Standard: A requirement may remain unsatisfied while its verified cost and lawful funding path are preserved.
When: Required readiness cost cannot yet be paid
Action: Record requirement/cost, search lawful resources, and do not represent requirement as satisfied.

Standard: A summary, index, architecture record or partial compilation is not the complete Legacy/AMOS unless underlying work is materialized and verified.
When: Completeness is described
Action: State actual scope and preserve unresolved source gaps.

Standard: A Governance decision is not complete at the vote; it must return clarity, protection, learning, capability, restoration or another responsible institutional value.
When: A Governance decision is made
Action: Use the G01 Council Decision Record spine and route the decision through learning/reflection/continuity/AMOS as applicable.

Standard: G01-F01 through G01-F08 operate as one integrated Governance Record Package; the Council Decision Record is the spine.
When: A matter enters formal Governance
Action: Use the integrated package and preserve the record chain; do not create a parallel governance record system.

Standard: R03-F01–R03-F08 operate as one continuity package: Readiness → Container → Context → Transfer → Demonstration → Gap Correction → Verification → Closure & Return → IR03 → Renewal.
When: A continuity responsibility enters transfer, readiness, assurance or closure
Action: Use the complete package and preserve the record chain; do not split it into parallel controls.

Standard: Pay dates are the 15th and 30th, using the last calendar day when a month has no 30th. Every release requires two wet signatures.
When: Payroll is activated or any payroll release is prepared
Action: Alicia Walker + Indya Massey until Office Steward; then Office Steward + either Alicia Walker or Indya Massey. Retain the signed record.

Standard: Nothing intentionally established as part of the AMW Legacy may be silently altered, removed, renamed, or repurposed.
When: Any intentionally established architecture, rule, register, statement, identifier, placement, or responsibility is proposed for alteration/removal/rename/repurpose
Action: Check ML-001; identify source/current status; document deliberate amendment, renewal or retirement through proper authority; preserve provenance and do not create silent drift.

Standard: G01-OC01 through G01-OC18 are a locked Governance operating-controls family; their existence is verified even where exact individual names/text remain unrecovered.
When: Governance operating controls are recovered, published, amended, consolidated, or mapped
Action: Preserve G01-OC01–G01-OC18 identifiers; recover exact source text before field-level use; do not invent, silently renumber, collapse, or replace the family without documented source-backed change.

Standard: One process governs every Legacy award: Nominate → Eligibility Screen → Conflict Check → Evidence Review → Independent Scoring → Selection Circle → Verification → Honoree Consent → Recognition → Return & Record.
When: Any Legacy award cycle opens or a nominee enters selection
Action: Use the controlled Legacy Awards Control process; do not create award-by-award shadow processes.

Standard: Five voting seats: two relevant subject-matter reviewers, one AMW Steward reviewer, one Legacy/Community representative, one rotating independent reviewer; Selection Records Steward facilitates without a vote.
When: A Selection Circle is formed
Action: Apply conflict/recusal and the appropriate SC-G/SC-Y/SC-T/SC-C/SC-A/SC-S/SC-B/SC-P expertise adaptation.

Standard: Scored awards use five weighted criteria totaling 100, five independent reviewer scores, normal threshold 80, variance review and neutral tie rule. Founder-designated PC-01 Participant Choice awards use verified equal ballots instead of reviewer scoring.
When: Any award is scored or a Participant Choice ballot is used
Action: Use the Award Scoring Template for scored awards. Use the dedicated PC-01 process for Participant Choice awards. No hidden bonus points, popularity manipulation or last-minute subjective tie preference.

Trigger / Rule: Pebble of the Year Child Eligibility
Standard: PEBBLE OF THE YEAR is a child / Future Legacy Creator award.
When: PEBBLE OF THE YEAR nominations are screened
Action: Reject adult nominations before scoring; use SC-Y and age/opportunity/developmentally appropriate evidence.

Trigger / Rule: Dave's Ultimate Good Doggie Team Eligibility
Standard: Dave's Ultimate Good Doggie recognizes the dog and handler together as one honoree team.
When: Dave's Ultimate Good Doggie nominations are screened
Action: Score the dog+handler pair as a unit; welfare outranks performance and breed/pedigree/appearance never earns points.

Standard: Barclay's Choice uses the Legacy-wide awards process with the SC-B animal-agency adaptation and dedicated ordinary-observation evidence.
When: Either Barclay's Choice award cycle opens
Action: Use Barclay Best Buddy process; preserve five eligible independent votes, canine welfare/training expertise and the Universal Scoring Rule.

Standard: Neither Best Trainer nor Best Comfort Buddy may be awarded without credible evidence of Barclay's voluntary positive engagement and welfare.
When: A Barclay's Choice nominee reaches finalist/verification review
Action: Verify voluntary approach/engagement, welfare and evidence integrity. If behavior is ambiguous, stressed, avoidant, inconsistent or materially influenced, the gate does not pass and no recipient may be selected.

Standard: No person may manufacture Barclay's preference for an award through force, repeated calling, monopolized access, staged distress, head-to-head competition, special inducement during selection observations or other manipulation.
When: Barclay selection observations are planned or conducted
Action: Use ordinary low-pressure interactions; record context; exclude materially influenced observation evidence and review eligibility if conduct compromised welfare.

Standard: Founder-designated Participant Choice awards are determined by verified equal participant ballots after eligibility/safety/welfare screening; the Selection Circle verifies but does not substitute its preference.
When: A Participant Choice award cycle opens
Action: Define eligible participants/candidates before voting; one eligible participant = one private ballot; abstention allowed; verify welfare/integrity; use the predetermined neutral tie rule.

Standard: PREPPIEST PONY recognizes the eligible horse receiving the highest verified valid participant ballot count.
When: PREPPIEST PONY voting cycle is prepared or counted
Action: Use PC-01 and the Preppiest Pony process. Do not score appearance, value, pedigree, speed, skill or handler popularity. The horse—not the handler—is the honoree.

Trigger / Rule: PREPPIEST PONY — No Campaigning / Welfare Gate
Standard: Horse welfare and ballot integrity outrank winning. Handlers/staff/supporters may not manufacture votes through pressure, treats during voting, staged access, advertising or directing participant choice.
When: Horse eligibility or voting integrity is reviewed
Action: Protect horse rest/medical needs without penalty; remove materially influenced ballots/evidence where appropriate; if integrity cannot be responsibly restored, no recipient is required.

Standard: Every Friday is a half day, tied to self-care/work-home balance and burnout prevention.
When: Weekly Friday scheduling for every AMW institution, site, village and fleet program
Action: Build Friday staffing/coverage so the half-day is honored without abandoning continuous-care, resident, animal, clinical, food, safety, transportation, emergency or legal responsibilities. Continuous operations use staggered/rotating coverage rather than treating the policy as permission to leave responsibilities uncovered.

Standard: At the beginning of each month, vote for an end-of-month Village Building and Appreciation Day to give back to Stewards and Community Partners.
When: Beginning of each month and before the selected end-of-month day
Action: Conduct and record the monthly vote; confirm the selected day, responsible Steward, service/coverage plan, accessibility, resource/budget readiness and any partner/participant boundaries; preserve the appreciation purpose and route learning/Return through AMOS.

Trigger / Rule: Institution Entrance Just Love Pond Check
Standard: Every current and future AMW Legacy institution has a Just Love Pond near its principal/public entrance.
When: A new institution/site is designed, an existing institution design is revised, or an entrance/arrival plan is reviewed
Action: Verify the Just Love Pond is included near the principal/public entrance; confirm accessible/egress/emergency circulation and public safety; if living aquatic elements are used, apply JLP-001 and applicable JLC global welfare/legal/ecology/life-support controls.

Standard: No pain, stress or fear is considered humane for AMW participants, human and animals alike. Pain/stress/fear may not be intentionally used as training, discipline, motivation, entertainment, selection or ordinary program method.
When: Any AMW participant-facing activity, training, handling, clinical/veterinary interaction, program, institution, village, site or fleet function
Action: STOP the harmful method; protect the participant; use the least-harmful responsible pathway. Necessary lawful clinical/veterinary/emergency intervention must minimize, monitor and relieve distress through qualified authority and may not be mislabeled as the humane method.

Trigger / Rule: Abuse Immediate Protection / Termination / Criminal Reporting
Standard: Abuse of any kind is a Legacy-wide full-stop.
When: Any credible indication or verified abuse involving a human or animal participant
Action: Immediately protect/separate where AMW has authority, preserve evidence, obtain emergency care, escalate and make required reports. Verified abuse is grounds for immediate termination where AMW has lawful authority and criminal/protective/licensing referral to the fullest extent legally available; IR02 cannot replace immediate protection/accountability.

Standard: All institutional budgets are presented by the 15th of every month.
When: Monthly institutional financial cycle
Action: Submit/present the institutional budget into the controlled financial record by the 15th; preserve variance, restriction, authorization and unresolved-item traceability.

Standard: All institutional receipts are presented with the monthly budget.
When: Monthly budget submission
Action: Attach/reconcile possessed receipts with the budget package; identify missing receipts as missing rather than reconstructing or representing them as possessed.

Standard: Steward schedules and leave requests for all institutions are provided by Wednesday before close of business to institutional HR for the following week.
When: Weekly staffing / leave planning
Action: Institutional HR verifies staffing, credentials/authorization, continuous coverage, accommodations, emergency duties and Friday Half-Day coverage before final schedule release.

Standard: Every institution is built and maintained to applicable state/regional requirements and continues updating as regulations change.
When: Design, build, activation, renewal, inspection or material service change
Action: Maintain current required licenses, permits, registrations, inspections, credentials, instructor/learner-supervision and sanitation authorizations; expired/suspended/unverified/scope-incompatible authority is a stop gate for the affected service.

Standard: Each institution maintains the required sanitation, authorization, consent, incident, chemical/SDS, linen, equipment, licensing, commissioning, accessibility and learning-return records.
When: Institution readiness and ongoing operation
Action: Maintain the required record when the function exists; if the function genuinely does not exist, record N/A with reason/responsible authority rather than silently omitting the control.

Standard: A children’s area cannot function as unsupervised childcare unless separately authorized/licensed where required and properly staffed.
When: Any institution provides a children’s room, play area, enrichment area or child-focused space
Action: Keep the area within its authorized purpose and supervision model; stop unsupervised childcare activity unless separate legal/program/staffing readiness is established.

Standard: Read and analyze the Founder prompt/response in its entirety and cross-reference the latest updated-and-saved Legacy work against every applicable established, non-superseded control, guideline, safeguard, full-stop, Statement Placement requirement, locked boundary, prior Founder direction, source/provenance record and current artifact.
When: Any Founder prompt, correction, follow-up, research task, application, funding review, artifact, visual, recommendation, update/save direction or response
Action: Cross-reference before drafting or acting. Apply inherited controls automatically. A later omission, summary, visual or artifact does not supersede an established control; identify genuine conflict/source gap rather than silently bypassing the control.

Standard: When the Founder says Update and Save to the Legacy, Save, Update, or otherwise explicitly directs that named work be saved/updated, the exact named item is immediately authorized for durable Legacy integration as-is.
When: Any explicit Founder save/update direction
Action: Preserve the exact work; update the active controlled record; durably save/verify the exact artifact in Drive; preserve supersession/provenance. Do not hold, stage, summarize in place of saving, or require another confirmation phrase. Founder-named save/update authority controls that item.

Trigger / Rule: No Blank Slate / Controlled Work Inheritance Gate
Standard: No Legacy work begins from a blank slate when applicable controlled work already exists. Every new action must inherit all applicable current, non-superseded Founder controls before execution.
When: Any new Legacy response, draft, rendering, manual, fleet action, research task, application, recommendation, update/save, implementation plan, or execution where applicable controlled work may already exist
Action: Before starting, retrieve and cross-reference the applicable current controlled work and inherit every applicable current, non-superseded Founder control. Preserve unaffected approved elements and change only what the Founder directs. If source work cannot be found or verified, identify/recover the source gap rather than recreating, inferring, or bypassing it. Blank-slate work is permitted only when no applicable controlled work exists or the Founder explicitly directs genuinely new work.

Trigger / Rule: Daily Assistant Mirror Review / Self-Governing Correction Gate
Standard: At 1:00 AM Eastern daily, conduct an IR02 Mirror Review of the prior day’s AMW Legacy work, including controls, safeguards, Founder prompts/responses, deliverables, save/update durability, funding/eligibility guidance, demographic assumptions, and any repeated Founder corrections.
When: Daily at 1:00 AM Eastern; additionally when a repeated pattern shows that a prior correction did not hold.
Action: Retrieve controlling sources, identify the actual break, correct the artifact/system proactively, verify the correction, make the correction durable where authorized, and report only what was corrected plus any issue that genuinely requires Founder direction. Do not wait for the Founder to re-prompt when the original request and governing control are already known.

Standard: When a failure or correction is known and governing requirement is already established, execute the repair without waiting for Founder repetition; acknowledgment alone does not close the issue.
When: ML-008; ML-007; ML-004; Problem Resolution / Source Recovery
Action: Before next dependent deliverable; closure requires verification or explicit unresolved status.

Standard: Before presenting any Legacy visual, verify the requested visual form and all applicable visible controls; captions do not substitute for physical depiction. For any fleet rendering, the exact controlled fleet must be shown with BOTH exterior and interior views for every vehicle family unless the Founder explicitly requests exterior-only. Accessibility distinctions must be physically represented where assigned, and mission-specific interior controls must be visible rather than merely labeled.
When: ML-009; ML-013; ML-014; ML-015; ML-018; ML-019; ML-020; Visual Execution Gate; Campus & Interior; Fleet/Institution Interior Cross-Refs
Action: Hold/cancel the artifact if required exterior/interior views, exact fleet checksum, assigned accessibility, mission-specific interiors, or controlled rendering type are absent. Regenerate/correct before presentation; a label, caption, or exterior-only image does not pass.

Standard: When Founder requests another angle/interior/fleet/uniform/detail after approval/save, preserve approved artifact unchanged and create separate supplemental view unless redesign is expressly ordered.
When: ML-010; Save/Update Automatic Durability; Supersession Control
Action: No silent redesign, merge, replacement or broadening.

Standard: If same control/deliverable failure recurs after identification/correction, escalate to IR02 Level 4 Strengthen and hold same-class output until preflight passes.
When: ML-012; ML-007; ML-008; Learning & Assurance
Action: Second occurrence or recurrence after Mirror Review.
